question: Add a new method HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error to the Discoverer interface in prometheus/discovery. Discoverer is used by Thanos and Prometheus to find scrape targets dynamically. Any custom service discovery implementation must now implement HealthCheck.
answer:
## Architecture Overview

The `Discoverer` interface is defined in `discovery/discovery.go` (line 35) in the prometheus repo. It currently has a single method: `Run(ctx context.Context, up chan<- []*targetgroup.Group)`. Adding `HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error` requires every type satisfying this interface to implement the new method.

There are two categories of implementors:
1. **Direct implementors** — types with their own `Run` method that must explicitly add `HealthCheck`.
2. **Embedding types** — types that embed `*refresh.Discovery` and inherit both `Run` and `HealthCheck` automatically once `refresh.Discovery` gets the new method.

The `discovery.Manager` in `discovery/manager.go` orchestrates providers via `startProvider()` (line 324), calling `p.d.Run(ctx, updates)`. It would also likely need to call `HealthCheck` on providers, e.g. before starting them or as part of health reporting.

## Detailed Analysis

### Prometheus — Interface Definition

- **`discovery/discovery.go`** — Defines the `Discoverer` interface (line 35-40) where `HealthCheck` must be added. Also contains `staticDiscoverer` (line 159) which directly implements `Discoverer` via its own `Run` method (line 161) and needs `HealthCheck`.

### Prometheus — Direct Implementors (own Run method, need explicit HealthCheck)

- **`discovery/refresh/refresh.go`** — `refresh.Discovery` struct (line 38) implements `Discoverer` with its own `Run` (line 67). This is the **base type** embedded by ~20 SD mechanisms (azure, docker, dockerswarm, http, digitalocean, dns, ec2, gce, hetzner, ionos, linode, marathon, nomad, openstack, ovhcloud, puppetdb, scaleway, triton, uyuni, vultr, etc.). Adding `HealthCheck` here propagates to all embedders automatically.
- **`discovery/consul/consul.go`** — `consul.Discovery` struct (line 172) has its own fields (no refresh embedding) and its own `Run` method. Needs explicit `HealthCheck`.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go`** — `kubernetes.Discovery` struct (line 255) has its own `Run` method and manages sub-discoverers (`discoverers []discovery.Discoverer`, line 261). Needs explicit `HealthCheck`.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/pod.go`** — `Pod` struct (line 46) implements `Discoverer` as a k8s sub-discoverer. Needs `HealthCheck`.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/node.go`** — `Node` struct implements `Discoverer` as a k8s sub-discoverer. Needs `HealthCheck`.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/service.go`** — `Service` struct implements `Discoverer` as a k8s sub-discoverer. Needs `HealthCheck`.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/endpoints.go`** — `Endpoints` struct implements `Discoverer` as a k8s sub-discoverer. Needs `HealthCheck`.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/endpointslice.go`** — `EndpointSlice` struct implements `Discoverer` as a k8s sub-discoverer. Needs `HealthCheck`.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/ingress.go`** — `Ingress` struct implements `Discoverer` as a k8s sub-discoverer. Needs `HealthCheck`.
- **`discovery/file/file.go`** — `file.Discovery` struct has its own `Run` method (no refresh embedding). Needs explicit `HealthCheck`.
- **`discovery/zookeeper/zookeeper.go`** — `zookeeper.Discovery` struct (line 140) has its own `Run` method (line 200). Both `NewServersetDiscovery` and `NewNerveDiscovery` return this type. Needs `HealthCheck`.
- **`discovery/xds/xds.go`** — `fetchDiscovery` struct (line 99) has its own `Run` method (line 111). Used by Kuma SD. Needs `HealthCheck`.
- **`discovery/manager_test.go`** — `testDiscoverer` (line 1520) and `lockStaticDiscoverer` test types implement `Discoverer` directly. Need `HealthCheck`.

### Prometheus — Manager / Orchestration

- **`discovery/manager.go`** — `Manager.startProvider` (line 324) calls `p.d.Run(ctx, updates)` on `Discoverer` instances. The `Provider` struct (line 39) holds `d Discoverer` (line 41). May need to call `HealthCheck` before starting providers or for health reporting.

### Prometheus — Embedding Types (auto-inherit from refresh.Discovery)

These embed `*refresh.Discovery` and automatically inherit `HealthCheck` once it's added to `refresh.Discovery`. No explicit code change needed unless they want custom health check behavior:
- `discovery/azure/azure.go` — `azure.Discovery` (line 172, embeds at line 173)
- `discovery/moby/docker.go` — `DockerDiscovery` (line 121, embeds at line 122)
- `discovery/moby/dockerswarm.go` — `moby.Discovery` (line 117, embeds at line 118)
- `discovery/http/http.go` — `http.Discovery` (line 107, embeds at line 108)
- And ~15+ more SD mechanisms (digitalocean, dns, ec2, gce, hetzner, ionos, linode, marathon, nomad, openstack, ovhcloud, puppetdb, scaleway, triton, uyuni, vultr, etc.)

### External — OpenTelemetry Operator

- **`cmd/otel-allocator/internal/target/discovery.go`** — The OTel allocator imports `github.com/prometheus/prometheus/discovery` (line 19) and uses `discovery.Manager` to manage SD providers. While it has its own `Discoverer` struct (line 33), this is NOT an implementation of prometheus's `Discoverer` interface — it wraps a `discovery.Manager`. Impact is indirect: upgrading the prometheus dependency would pull in the new interface, affecting any custom SD providers registered with the manager.

### External — Thanos

Thanos does NOT directly implement the prometheus `Discoverer` interface. Thanos has its own discovery package (`pkg/discovery/`) with DNS and memcache resolvers that use different interfaces. The Thanos sidecar interacts with Prometheus at the HTTP API level, not by implementing `Discoverer`. No direct code changes needed in Thanos for this interface change.
